issue_request: FHIR-31780 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested a distinct status for the medication-definition resources that lacked one, with the final resolution requiring draft/active/retired/unknown publication-status values at cardinality 1..1, isModifier=true, and the same treatment for Ingredient.
initial_application: The change was applied before this reconciliation by f67c15e888009caabbf25f8cb4a324d0bc8bf850 and b838576d2f726fc94ace6867447a3f6cfa6f5576, both titled 'Ingredient.status and ManufacturedItemDefinition and AdministrableProductDefinition FHIR-31780'. Those commits added the status elements and active example values; the Jira comment says the change was applied in the R4B branch and main build.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists AdministrableProductDefinition, ManufacturedItemDefinition, and Ingredient as active current-build resources. BRR minutes from 2021-10-05 confirm the vote and the three-resource status scope. FHIR-31790 and FHIR-31830 are companion status-family issues already represented on the combined branch, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current StructureDefinition sources already define AdministrableProductDefinition.status, ManufacturedItemDefinition.status, and Ingredient.status as 1..1 code elements with modifier=true and required bindings to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/publication-status, and the checked-in examples include active status values.
